step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts a serverless geospatial conversion and validation pipeline. 1. A developer (UserCompanyDeveloper) interacts with API Gateway to upload a GeoTIFF file. 2. API Gateway stores the GeoTIFF in Amazon S3. 3. S3 notifies a ThirdParty provider which converts the GeoTIFF to a LandXML file and returns it to S3. 4. The LandXML file landing in S3 triggers AWS Step Functions. 5. Step Functions invokes Lambda Validation and Lambda Render functions in parallel. 6. Lambda Render writes validation state and results to Amazon DynamoDB. 7. DynamoDB triggers Amazon SNS notifications for alerts and status updates.
